{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgoZ6e1MPR6311jCPQTGi","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017HyswAP2Dq2ABwcs9dLbmo","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > nbody/nbody.cpp <<'EOF'\n// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA N-body benchmark.\n//\n// Decomposition:\n//   * MPI     : every rank owns a contiguous block of bodies. Each step the rank\n//               computes forces / integrates its own bodies against the full\n//               position set and the updated positions are exchanged with\n//               MPI_Allgatherv (host staged in pinned memory).\n//   * OpenMP  : one host thread per GPU attached to the rank drives its CUDA\n//               stream concurrently (ranks with several visible GPUs split\n//               their block across them). OpenMP is also used for the host\n//               side O(N) passes (validation, result packing).\n//   * CUDA    : the O(N^2) force evaluation and the energy evaluation run on\n//               the GPU with shared-memory tiling of the position set. The j\n//               range is additionally split into K chunks so that small local\n//               blocks still produce enough threads to fill the device; the\n//               chunk partial sums are reduced in a fixed order.\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\nconstexpr int BLOCK = 256;  // threads per block == bodies per shared-memory tile\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__, __LINE__,          \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__));                                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                       \\\n        }                                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Partial force on local body i (global index start+i) from the j-chunk blockIdx.y.\n// pos: full position array (x,y,z interleaved), partial: SoA [K][3][nLocal].\n__global__ void forcesKernel(const double* __restrict__ pos, const int n, const int start, const int nLocal,\n                             const int chunkLen, double* __restrict__ partial) {\n    __shared__ double sh[3 * BLOCK];\n\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * BLOCK + threadIdx.x;\n    const int c = blockIdx.y;\n    const int jBegin = c * chunkLen;\n    const int jEnd = min(n, jBegin + chunkLen);\n\n    double px = 0.0, py = 0.0, pz = 0.0;\n    if (i < nLocal) {\n        const double* p = pos + 3 * (size_t)(start + i);\n        px = p[0];\n        py = p[1];\n        pz = p[2];\n    }\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n    for (int tile = jBegin; tile < jEnd; tile += BLOCK) {\n        const int cnt = min(BLOCK, jEnd - tile);\n        for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < 3 * cnt; t += BLOCK) sh[t] = pos[3 * (size_t)tile + t];\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (i < nLocal) {\n#pragma unroll 8\n            for (int j = 0; j < cnt; ++j) {\n                const double dx = sh[3 * j + 0] - px;\n                const double dy = sh[3 * j + 1] - py;\n                const double dz = sh[3 * j + 2] - pz;\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n                Fx += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (i < nLocal) {\n        double* out = partial + (size_t)c * 3 * nLocal;\n        out[0 * (size_t)nLocal + i] = Fx;\n        out[1 * (size_t)nLocal + i] = Fy;\n        out[2 * (size_t)nLocal + i] = Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Reduce the K chunk partials in fixed order, kick the velocity, drift the position.\n__global__ void updateKernel(const double* __restrict__ partial, const int K, const int start, const int nLocal,\n                             double* __restrict__ vel, double* __restrict__ pos) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * BLOCK + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= nLocal) return;\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n    for (int c = 0; c < K; ++c) {\n        const double* in = partial + (size_t)c * 3 * nLocal;\n        Fx += in[0 * (size_t)nLocal + i];\n        Fy += in[1 * (size_t)nLocal + i];\n        Fz += in[2 * (size_t)nLocal + i];\n    }\n\n    double* v = vel + 3 * (size_t)i;\n    const double vx = v[0] + DT * Fx;\n    const double vy = v[1] + DT * Fy;\n    const double vz = v[2] + DT * Fz;\n    v[0] = vx;\n    v[1] = vy;\n    v[2] = vz;\n\n    double* p = pos + 3 * (size_t)(start + i);\n    p[0] += vx * DT;\n    p[1] += vy * DT;\n    p[2] += vz * DT;\n}\n\n// Total energy contribution of the local bodies (unit mass):\n// kinetic 0.5*v^2 plus half of the pair potential -1/dist over all j != i.\n__global__ void energyKernel(const double* __restrict__ pos, const double* __restrict__ vel, const int n,\n                             const int start, const int nLocal, double* __restrict__ blockSums) {\n    __shared__ double sh[3 * BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double red[BLOCK];\n\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * BLOCK + threadIdx.x;\n    const int gi = start + i;\n\n    double px = 0.0, py = 0.0, pz = 0.0, e = 0.0;\n    if (i < nLocal) {\n        const double* p = pos + 3 * (size_t)gi;\n        px = p[0];\n        py = p[1];\n        pz = p[2];\n        const double* v = vel + 3 * (size_t)i;\n        e = 0.5 * (v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]);\n    }\n\n    double pe = 0.0;\n    for (int tile = 0; tile < n; tile += BLOCK) {\n        const int cnt = min(BLOCK, n - tile);\n        for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < 3 * cnt; t += BLOCK) sh[t] = pos[3 * (size_t)tile + t];\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (i < nLocal) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < cnt; ++j) {\n                if (tile + j == gi) continue;\n                const double dx = sh[3 * j + 0] - px;\n                const double dy = sh[3 * j + 1] - py;\n                const double dz = sh[3 * j + 2] - pz;\n                pe -= 1.0 / sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    e += 0.5 * pe;\n\n    red[threadIdx.x] = e;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = BLOCK / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) red[threadIdx.x] += red[threadIdx.x + s];\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) blockSums[blockIdx.x] = red[0];\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n Only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `nbody`, and no new files or dependencies were added.\n\n**How the parallelization works**\n\n- **MPI** splits the bodies into contiguous blocks, one per rank. Each step a rank computes forces for its own block against the full position set, then the updated positions are exchanged with an in-place allgather through pinned host memory. Ranks on the same node are detected with a shared-memory communicator and mapped round-robin onto the node's GPUs.\n- **OpenMP** runs one host thread per GPU attached to a rank, so a single rank per node drives all local GPUs concurrently with its own CUDA stream per device. OpenMP also parallelizes the host-side O(N) passes for validation and result packing.\n- **CUDA** does the O(N²) force evaluation and the energy evaluation with shared-memory tiling of positions. The j range is split into K chunks sized from the SM count so that small per-GPU slices still fill the device, and the chunk partials are reduced in a fixed order in a fused kick-drift kernel. Kernel modules are preloaded before the timer starts so lazy loading never lands in the timed region.\n\n**Correctness** was checked against the original build with 1 rank on 1 GPU, 1 rank on 4 GPUs, and 2, 4, 6, and 8 ranks, including odd sizes and the one-body and zero-body cases. Results agree to roughly 1e-12 relative, and the one-body case is bitwise identical. The hash differs from the original only because the summation order differs. Validation passes and the exit codes match.\n\n**Performance** on this machine with four RTX 3090s:\n\n| Configuration | 4096 bodies, 10 steps | 65536 bodies, 10 steps |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original serial CPU | 1238 ms | not run |\n| 1 rank, 1 GPU | 21 ms | 3977 ms |\n| 1 rank, 4 GPUs via OpenMP | 6 ms | 1005 ms |\n| 4 MPI ranks, 1 GPU each | 7 ms | 1024 ms |\n\nScaling across the four GPUs is near linear at the larger size, in either the one-rank or four-rank layout.\n\n**Build notes.** The source stays a `.cpp` file but is compiled by nvcc through a CMake source property. CMake now requires MPI, OpenMP, and the CUDA toolkit, defaults to Release, and targets compute capabilities 70, 80, 86, and 90 unless `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` is set. All runs here were launched with plain `mpirun`, and host staging means a CUDA-aware MPI is not required."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":455,"cache_read_input_tokens":48468,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":455},"output_tokens":775,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bde0391c-d037-4b65-bbb0-fc9210b342f4","uuid":"9c45b256-27d9-4dc6-89c6-7190e9457fe4","timestamp":"2026-11-07T12:25:21.125Z","request_id":"req_011CgoZddCMqCuS3kwr1yJm9"}
